column1: 1. assert_instance type assertion provides before timespec validation
2. timespec_check error handling does not provide for unsupported timespec values
3. raise_error error raise too early when timespec is 'nanoseconds'
4. return_result output return too late after format_result
5. format_result formatting executes out of order when timespec_check incorrectly jumps to raise_error
6. assert_instance stop stopped too soon when input is None
7. assert_len length assertion applies for too long when result string has length 0
8. start initial input provides before validation
9. end completion signal does not provide to caller
10. format_result formatting too early before length assertion
